name: chart-line

frames.best_why: Shows all three line cards fully drawn with no tooltip covering any of the series or labels.

tagline: Three small line charts: multiple series, coloured dots and labels.
summary: A row of dark cards each holding a line chart. One plots two series, one marks each point in a colour, and one writes values above the dots.
appearance: Three bordered dark cards sit side by side with thin grey line charts on faint horizontal gridlines. The first has two crossing lines, the second a line with coloured dots, the third a dotted line with number labels over each point.
behaviour: Hovering a point brings up a small tooltip with the month and series values, and the active dot grows. The labelled chart keeps its numbers above the dots at all times.
demo_content: Visitor lines for January to June 2024 labelled Desktop and Mobile, plus browser names with counts.
use_when: A dashboard needs small trend lines for one or two series with clear points.
avoid_when: Every card hardcodes its data and titles, so each variant needs editing before reuse.
customise: Each variant hardcodes its data, title and footer; reuse means replacing those arrays and chart configs in the file.
weight_why: Three small SVG line charts with six points; no animation loop.

a11y.note: The accessibility layer names the charts, but tooltip values remain pointer-only.

polish_why: Clean standard line charts, but grey and largely interchangeable.
